What is the MOQ for Precision Instrument Case?

Standard SKUs 50-100 pcs, custom 300 pcs. Larger quantities get better pricing.

Can Precision Instrument Case be customized with logo?

Yes. Silk-screen, hot stamping, laser engraving, UV spray - 4 options, MOQ 100pcs.

What certifications for Precision Instrument Case?

CE / RoHS / ISO9001 standard. UN38.3, FDA, UL, MIL-SPEC optional.

How long for export delivery?

What are the trade terms?

FOB Shenzhen / EXW Zhongshan, T/T 30% deposit, 70% balance before shipment.
